verdict.rationale: The GitHub README lists 'Pinning Rules (Merchandising)', which covers pinning specific hits for queries. It also lists 'Fields Boosting', but that is field-level weighting, not per-query hit boosting. Nothing in the pack shows synonym definitions or hiding or excluding hits for specific queries, and the pinning claim is only a feature-list bullet with no detailed docs. Missing for 10: synonym support, per-query hide/exclude rules, per-query document boosting, in-depth documentation of pinning rules, independent or hands-on corroboration.
